title: Interfaces for normalized strict-tower compactification comparisons
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the strict quotient tower with positive level $R_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^{n+1}$ and its ringed sequence-site presentation [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Record the following comparison interfaces on its ordinary unbounded derived categories. Base is a sectionwise identity presentation with its coefficient calculus; Operations consists of the normalized geometric adjunctions, exact open extension, pullback compositors and the open-adjunction-transposed tensor map. OpenExchange is fixed by the inverse open-unit transpose. ComparisonLevels records their finite coefficient analogues, with tensor pullback pinned to the generic normalized model. StrictSystemComparisons asks for extension of the selected system calculus to SemilinearDerivedSectionsData, the actual tensor reduction equation, scalar/tensor associativity and composition of coefficient direct-image mates. StrictPlusComparisons and StrictPlusEvaluation record inclusion-compatible bounded-below derived adjunctions and evaluation. StrictWordComparisons records naturality of the compactification projection and evaluation of both complete proper/open words. The finite realization is the exact derived identity-section module equivalence, with underlying comparison equal to the additive sheafification counit. Its pullback and open squares are the termwise localizations of the ordinary realization squares. StrictFiniteCoordinates records the right-adjoint comparison determined by this pullback square and both unit/counit equations. StrictFiniteExchangeComparisons identifies the finite exchange with the witness-transported etale exchange [lem-pur-co-smooth-exchange-transport]. StrictFiniteProjectionComparisons includes the finite tensor isomorphism, its fixed underlying sheaf and signed-total representative pins [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization], and identification with the published projection word [def-exchange-projection]. StrictCompactificationComparisons is the conjunction of these clauses for common choices of levels and finite coordinates. These are the existing interfaces moved unchanged into a data module; no operation or comparison is newly postulated.
